guidance.metric_label: 500 racks to last at least 1.5 years
guidance.quote: we feel the 500 racks that we have, with the proper off-take that has already happened, will sustain ourselves for at least a minimum of 1.5 years.
guidance.speaker: Management (BSE)

guidance.condition: Described as an aspiration; the speaker said BSE does not measure success by market share
guidance.quote: maybe by the beginning of the calendar year 2027, we should have touched at least a very meaningfully double-digit market share in cash market.
guidance.speaker: Management (BSE)

insights.summary: Q1 FY27 operating EBITDA rose 67% to ₹1,046 Cr (67% margin) and net profit 62% to ₹539 Cr. Management said its 500 co-location racks should last at least 1.5 years, and aspires to a double-digit cash-equity market share by early calendar 2027.

what_changed.text: 500 co-location racks now fully built; enough for 1.5 years
Aspiration of double-digit cash-market share by early CY2027

tone.label: confident
tone.quote: Overall, Q1 FY27 was another strong quarter for BSE

analyst_questions.answer: 500 racks in place; off-take gradual; charges raised and order-flow charges added.

analyst_questions.topic: Impact of higher STT on futures
analyst_questions.answer: Futures are lightly traded on BSE, so the effect is minimal.
Institutional volumes rising; aspiration to be double-digit by early 2027.

red_flags.text: Cash-equity market share is still well short of 10%.
Earnings are tied to index-options volumes, which are regulated and cyclical.

business_snapshot.what_they_make: BSE stock exchange: equity, derivatives, SME platform, BSE Star MF, co-location and data
business_snapshot.customers: Brokers, institutions, 26 crore investor accounts, issuers
business_snapshot.demand_drivers: Index options volumes, IPOs, SME listings, mutual-fund distribution
